drivingQuestion: What reward is due to one who hosts a Torah scholar in his home?
outcomeNote: A single homiletical unit in the vineyard-of-Yavne series; nothing is challenged and nothing is resolved against anyone.

segments.he: פָּתַח רַבִּי נְחֶמְיָה בִּכְבוֹד אַכְסַנְיָא וְדָרַשׁ: מַאי דִּכְתִיב ״וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל הַקֵּינִי לְכוּ סֻּרוּ רְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִי פֶּן אוֹסִפְךָ עִמּוֹ וְאַתָּה עָשִׂיתָה חֶסֶד עִם כׇּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל״? וַהֲלֹא דְּבָרִים קַל וָחוֹמֶר: וּמָה יִתְרוֹ שֶׁלֹּא קֵרַב אֶת מֹשֶׁה אֶלָּא לִכְבוֹד עַצְמוֹ — כָּךְ, הַמְאָרֵחַ תַּלְמִיד חָכָם בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ, וּמַאֲכִילוֹ וּמַשְׁקֵהוּ וּמְהַנֵּהוּ מִנְּכָסָיו — עַל אַחַת כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה.
segments.en: The Gemara returns to the homilies offered by the Sages in the vineyard of Yavne. «Rabbi Neḥemya began» to speak «in honor of the hosts and taught: What is» the meaning of «that which is written: “And Saul said unto the Kenites: Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites lest I destroy you with them, for you showed kindness to all the Children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt”» (I Samuel 15:6)? «Isn’t this an a fortiori inference: Just as Jethro,» the forbearer of the Kenite tribe, who «only befriended Moses for his own honor,» is treated «in this way» and rewarded that his merit would protect his descendants; «all the more so» should «one who hosts a Torah scholar in his home, providing him with food and drink and availing him of his possessions,» be rewarded with that protection.
